resources.string: When blocking is enabled, calls from numbers not in your contacts are blocked before your phone rings.
Android call-screening access is required before blocking can work.
Use this button to grant notification access or open Android settings where blocked-call notifications can be turned off.
Notifications for calls blocked because the number is not in Contacts
Android—not this app—determines whether a number belongs to Contacts. This app does not read your contacts.
Limitation: Android does not send restricted, unknown, unavailable, or payphone caller IDs to third-party call-screening apps.
